title: 心理学統計法
subtitle: Psychological Statistics
educationalGoal: Statistical analysis is required for psychological research with high generalizability. The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge to run statistical tests and to understand the results of the tests precisely.
advice: The class proceeds with lectures on the basic theory of psychological statistics and practical training of statistical analyses that include calculations with real data using Microsoft Excel. Students are expected to understand the basics of psychological statistics and learn the method of statistical analysis to avoid misuse of statistical analysis and misinterpretation of the results of analyses. Note that the course flow can be changed according to other closely related courses such as “Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments.” Note: This course is required for Certified Public Psychologists & Certified Psychologists.
books: Textbooks:Sugaku ga negate demo wakaru shinri toukeihou nyumon: kiso kara tahenryou kaiseki made, Science
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to bring their own personal computer with Microsoft Excel and other software for statistical analysis.

activityGoals.body: Ability to decide which statistical analyses are appropriate for the data acquired in experiments and surveys.
Ability to run statistical analyses with appropriate methods and to interpret the results in appropriate ways.
Ability to understand the selection, computation, and interpretation of descriptive statistics.
